assertion_results.text: Investigation records that risk_score is written at ingestion time (assessment creation) and is NOT recomputed on read, confirming a data migration is needed (Step 3 persistence-impact analysis)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md findings table: 'Write timing | Ingestion time: written once when the assessment is created and never recomputed on read or updated afterwards', 'Self-correcting? | No.' and 'Data migration required | Yes'. assertion_results.text: Task description Implementation Notes includes migration logic to recompute and update existing risk_score values in the assessments table (Step 5 data migration)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md Implementation Notes, 'Migration logic for up.sql': the preferred option is to 'recompute risk_score = vulnerable_count::float8 / NULLIF(total_count, 0)'. The fallback SQL is 'UPDATE assessments SET risk_score = CASE WHEN risk_score = 'Infinity'::float8 OR risk_score = 'NaN'::float8 THEN 0.0 ELSE 1.0 / risk_score END WHERE risk_score > 1.0 OR risk_score = 'NaN'::float8;'.
